topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Well, neighbor, it seems a young squire went to the university, and now his words are read by all. They took his essay, a piece of his heart, and put it on show. I can only imagine the mix of pride and unease he must feel. It’s like when you plant a seed, thinking it’s just for your plot, and suddenly, the whole village is talking of its bloom. It’s a big step, a spread of one’s thoughts beyond the hearth. May the good saints watch over him, as his words now travel far and wide, and may the earth give him more to share.
